newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease to end at 20.875 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease to end at 20.875 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates eased slightly on Monday in continued abundant liquidity and were likely to remain low over the next days, traders said.
"This was the impact of Friday's money inflow," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
He was reffering to the fact that more government bonds matured last week than new ones auctioned, thus some tens of billions of forints hit the market.
Overnight rates finished at 20.875 percent on Monday after trading between 20.75 and 21.25 percent, he said.

Tolonics added that overnight rates were likely to hold current levels unless large amounts of money are placed in the central bank's one-month reverse repo facility, currently standing at 21.50 percent.
"If overnight rates remain under 21 percent for a longer time, some players might put their funds into the one-month reverse repo," he said.
